title: Homogeneous fractions lift with every denominator formula
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[x0,x1] with its standard grading [def-sc-p1-standard], P=Proj S, G an O_P-module and M a Z-graded S-module with additive pieces M_z and S_n M_z contained in M_(n+z). Let phi_z be additive equivalences M_z -> Gamma(P,G tensor O_P(z)) for z>=0, compatible with homogeneous multiplication [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. For f in S_d, define Rel(x,s) to mean that some m>=0 and y in M_(m*d) satisfy x=y/f^m in M_f and that phi_(m*d)(y) restricts to multiplication of s by f^m on D+(f). Assume d>0, G coherent [pqf-def-coherent], M internally graded and M_z=0 for z<0. For every x in degreeZeroFractions [def-sc-degree-zero-module-fractions], there is s with Rel(x,s) such that, for every m and y in M_(m*d), x=y/f^m implies the displayed restriction formula for y and s.

source.place: Proposition 0BXD, final paragraph; parent chart proof step 1

proof.text:
If f=0, localization is zero and the standard open is empty; the zero section
works. Otherwise write the denominator as f^m. Its homogeneous degree is m*d,
by uniqueness of degree for nonzero homogeneous polynomials. The numerator
therefore lies in M_(m*d). Multiplication by f^m identifies G on D+(f) with
G tensor O(m*d): restrict unitToTwist, tensor with G and use the right unitor.
Apply its inverse to the restricted phi of the numerator. This yields the
required section and the displayed relation. For another representative,
LocalizedModule.mk_eq provides a power killing the cross multiplied
numerator difference. Apply phi and restrict; multiplication by the extra
power and by the first denominator is invertible on D+(f), giving the
formula for the other representative as well.
